title: 宝塚記念の後に・わらう？

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's a straight shot now! Will she continue to bide time on the inside? Takarazuka glory is just ahead!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (If you think about it, this whole "greatest dummy" thing is so ridiculous. It literally just sounds like a joke.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (But coming from Trainer's mouth… it feels like it could be real.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (I really am simple, but…)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (Apparently that's my strength. There are people who say they believe in me! So…)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Let's get dumb!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff… Wheeze…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …So sheer determination is all it takes to knock down doors, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just talking to myself… I've seen it not once, but twice now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tch. But that's what makes this game so exciting. The unpredictability.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So, Jordan. What's next for you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh, well, I…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm aiming for the world, no matter how bad my odds are. Seems the most exciting.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? The world? Isn't that, like, a pretty huge jump?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Gotta dream big, don't we? Which brings me back to my question.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just like I have my path, you have your own path that no one but you can walk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And given your penchant for flipping the entire board upside down, I bet that path leads to big things. So big not even I can imagine them.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: As a spectator, I look forward to it… to seeing whatever it is that only you can pull off.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Something only I can do?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (My goal is to become the greatest dummy there is.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (That's why I challenged Golshi—so I could surpass her.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: (But if I wanna be the greatest, period, then I might as well…)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, uh, can I talk to you about something?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So, you know how I'm gonna be the greatest, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, I wanna be faster, like, faster than any other runner.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Not just faster than my rivals, but faster than all those legends in the history textbooks. I want to like, become the textbook.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I wanna do something huge!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …You're trying not to laugh, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You think it's the dumbest idea ever.
choice_data_list: And that's what makes it great.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Let's be bigger and dumber than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan and I think about where we could make that a reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she wants to do something huge, a prestigious race where she'll be in the limelight would be our best bet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And she needs to run it fast enough to make history, which means we want the optimal distance for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which narrows it down to…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CRRRAAAASH!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whether ya asked for her or not, heeere's Golshi! Taaa-DAAAAA! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Golshi?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What's everyone talkin' about? Is it about how the lady at the seaweed shop marked everything half off?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Um, well… I'm gonna run in the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And I want you to race there too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whatchu talkin' 'bout?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We don't serve none of that fall Tenno at Golshi's. Why don't you spend some more time with the menu?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What? But we've been…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Like I said, it's not my race.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: If it's the race for you, then run it with pride.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Jordan's going to be the greatest dummy there is.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh, sounds fun. Maybe I should sell yakisoba to the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I should start stocking up now! I'm off to do some deep-sea fishing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Later, Jordan. Here, take this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Golshi…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Dear staff…"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Tosen Jordan and her trainer will hereby take responsibility for the repair of any doors that Gold Ship breaks from this point forward."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wai—Golshi! What the heck is this?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Just a notice I've been handing out to everyone! I'll leave the rest to you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There have been some benefits to being involved with Gold Ship. There have also been some things we could've done without.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At any rate, Tosen Jordan has decided on her next goal. We're going for the autumn Tenno Sho.
